encoding_notes: Source: live current Instructions for Authors fetched via Apify rag-web-browser headless render (WebFetch 402s on edmgr.ovid.com); HTTP 200, full guide captured.

Article-type mapping: Standard Review Article -> review; Research Article -> original_research; Surgical Technique Article -> technical_note; Letter to the Editor -> letter. JAAOS does NOT accept unsolicited editorials, so 'editorial' omitted. No case_report/case_series slot (not accepted); no systematic_review (JAAOS reviews are explicitly narrative expert distillations, 'specifically not a systematic review').

Folded/omitted types with no clean enum slot: Training Room (research OR review, 4000w/40ref/16 images), Orthopaedic Advances (review-type, 2250w/20ref/6 images), On the Horizon from the ORS (1500w/20ref/6 images). Committee/solicited-only types not author-submitted in the normal flow: AAOS CPG/AUC/Technology Overview summaries + case studies, Orthopaedic Video Theater.

SCHEMA GAP - combined figure+table cap: the guide caps 'total tables or figure images' (a single combined number), not separate figure and table maxes. Combined caps: review 16, research 16, surgical technique 8 (plus a required video), orthopaedic advances 6, on the horizon 6, letters 0. Encoded figures_max/tables_max as null (cannot split) except letters where the guide states 'None' (0). Letters also have no abstract ('None').

Abstract varies by type: research & training room = 300 words, 'Research structure'; standard review, surgical technique, orthopaedic advances, on the horizon = 200 words, 'Narrative structure'; letters = no abstract. Top-level abstract.structured set true (research 'Research structure'); abstract.max_words left null due to per-type variance (real caps live in word_limits). Guide does not enumerate the abstract subsection labels, so abstract.sections = null.

SCHEMA GAP - tiered figure DPI: line art must be vector or >=1200 dpi; electronic photographs/radiographs/CT/scanned images >=300 dpi; photographs containing text >=600 dpi. min_dpi encoded as 300 (the lowest floor); the 1200/600 tiers noted here.

References: AMA-style example ('Sonnadara RR, Van Vliet A, Safir O, et al: Title. Journal Year;Vol(Issue):Pages.'); guide also directs following the AMA Manual of Style for unit abbreviations. et_al_threshold=6 (list all author names up to six; for seven or more, list the first three plus et al). in_text=superscript is inferred from AMA/JAAOS house style: the guide states numeric-order in-text citation but does not explicitly state superscript vs bracket.
line_numbers: guide requires 'page and line numbers' but does not specify continuous vs per-page; encoded 'continuous' (enum has no null).

Blinding: title pages submitted as a SEPARATE file 'to allow for double blinded peer review' (double_blind + separate_title_page explicit). scrub_body_identifiers set true as implied by double-blind review (not a verbatim instruction to de-identify the body). Running head (<=40 chars incl. spaces) is placed at the BOTTOM OF THE TITLE PAGE, so it is captured as title_page.running_title, not a per-page layout.running_head (which is set show:false).

Tables: 'each table should begin on a new page' and figures are uploaded as separate files / not embedded; table placement encoded grouped_end (mild inference from LWW convention + 'new page' instruction). caption_position not explicitly stated -> null.
Figure formats acceptable per guide: .tif, .eps, .jpg, .pdf, .ppt (and .doc); encoded only enum-valid tif/eps/jpg/pdf (ppt/doc dropped). Visual abstracts require .png/.jpeg (separate item).

Visual Abstract is REQUIRED as of June 1, 2026 (review authors at submission; research authors at first revision) - no schema field, noted here. AI-generated content and AI-generated images are NOT permitted. Hybrid open-access option available; no APC if the free-publication option is chosen.
ISSN not stated on the guide page -> null. ORCID and cover letter not mentioned -> false (conservative).
